integrity.mathematical_scope: Exhaustive four-vertex classification with analytic finite spectral reduction and complete exact-rational finite certificate
integrity.proof_boundaries: A finite enumeration only because the theorem has a finite graph domain; no infinite-family conclusions are inferred.

scientific_limitations: Exact result only for unweighted simple connected four-vertex graphs under counting-measure ball averaging; no assertions for other orders, weights, or exponents. Independently established star and complete-graph formulas are explicitly attributed to prior work. Priority beyond the inspected literature remains uncertain.
title: Sharp Hilbert maximal norms on all connected four-vertex graphs
